manifest.title: Real: fake CBBTC honeypot on Base (reconstruction)
manifest.description: A real Base wallet bought a token named CBBTC in a $250k pool; Mobula static analysis later flagged it as a honeypot with a 100% sell tax, and the wallet itself sold 86% four minutes in. Reconstructed from Mobula REST history on 2026-09-04.
manifest.disclosure: Estimated reconstruction. Trades, prices and context were fetched from Mobula REST history after the fact (session d14b7b3e-a21d-47f3-91f2-520b92155de3, started 2026-09-04T17:39:42.799Z). Quotes are inferred from the price path and current pool depth, not observed.

payload.message: Estimated reconstruction via api.mobula.io: pool liquidity is the current reported value, not the value at trade time; 59 price points from 5s candles; impact reconstructed on current depth, not observed; 19 trades by other wallets and 1 source sells in the 300s window
